# Orca Reference Subset

This directory contains selected Orca reference source files copied from the upstream Orca repository for Codex Cloud visibility.

- Original repository: https://github.com/stablyai/orca
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE` in this directory)
- Purpose: reference/adaptation only
- Runtime use: do not import runtime code directly from this directory without review

The original Orca paths are preserved under this directory where practical.

Because this directory needs its own safety README, the upstream root `README.md` is stored as `UPSTREAM_README.md`.
